Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

QueueDepth.description: The depth of one queue and its effective limit.

bytes.description: Total stored size of those messages, in bytes.

deliveredUnacked.description: Messages in the queue whose state is `delivered` — handed out but not yet deleted by the recipient. Absent when the mediator did not measure it.

limit.description: The effective message-count limit for this queue after account overrides and mediator defaults are applied; -1 = unlimited.

oldestAgeSeconds.description: Age of the oldest message in the queue, in seconds. Absent when the queue is empty or the mediator did not measure it.

saturation.description: count ÷ limit. Absent when the limit is unlimited. May exceed 1 when a limit was lowered below the current depth.

QueueDepth.title: QueueDepth

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/stats/show request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/stats/show/0.1#response.

circuitBreaker.description: State of the store circuit breaker. `open` means the mediator is shedding store operations.

queueLength.description: Messages waiting to be forwarded to other mediators.

queues.description: Aggregate of the mediator's most recent queue survey. Absent when no survey has completed.

receive.description: Totals across every surveyed receive queue; `saturation` is the maximum of any single queue.

send.description: Totals across every surveyed send queue; `saturation` is the maximum of any single queue.

truncated.description: The survey stopped before covering every account.

totals.description: Lifetime counters since the mediator's store was created. Monotonic; a client derives rates from successive readings.

Response.title: Messaging — Show Mediator Statistics — response payload
